module.title: Atmospheric configurations: Held-Suarez and intermediate physics
module.expensive_path: The intermediate-complexity physics column (aim_v23: radiation, convection, condensation, surface fluxes per column per step, phy_driver.F) and the gray-radiation scheme in atm_phys, on top of the same dynamical core in pressure coordinates.
module.rationale: Same core, different fluid: pressure coordinate, different equation of state, and physics packages that no ocean deck uses. Separate physics is a separate task.
excluded: fizhi (the GEOS physics) is old, large and has no tutorial; propose it as a check pool only if the aim decks are too few
Coupled atmosphere-ocean (cpl_aim+ocn) needs two executables and a coupler, not packaged
hazards: Held-Suarez runs are chaotic at long horizons; the short graded windows stay pointwise
fizhi has its own non-standard grids (gridalt) and legacy code paths

approval.human_ref: looks rather nice, lets go? (2026-09-02, all six modules approved; package mitgcm-seaice first)
